title: A member backed up with Google gets a second, empty backup on a new phone through the WhatsApp check, and cannot switch back once they log a workout
what: Since 25 Nov the phone number check at welcome also signs the member in to a backup account for that number. This is a separate account from the Google one. A member whose workouts were saved with Google (the only way before 25 Nov) proves their number on a new phone, lands in an empty account and is told nothing is saved yet. Nothing links the two or tells them to use Google instead. After they log even one workout, Use Google instead is refused with 'This phone has another person's workouts', and the only way out is to erase the phone.
expected: The two sign-ins lead to the same saved workouts, or the welcome asks 'Saved with Google before?' first, and switching to Google on the member's own phone is never refused as another person.
who: members who saved workouts with Google and move to a new phone
how_often: every new phone or reinstall of such a member
fix_line: Join the number and the Google sign-in to one saved copy, or ask about Google before making a new number account

title: When bringing the saved copy back keeps failing, nothing new is saved and Settings still says the workouts are saved automatically
what: After a sign-in, a restore, an undo or a newer edit from another phone, the copy must first bring the server's copy back before it sends anything. If that keeps failing (sign-in run out, the server down or refusing), each try is only written to the phone's hidden log and nothing is sent. The Settings line is never told: it keeps showing 'saved automatically, last saved' with an old time, 'will be saved in a moment', or 'waiting for the internet', and never 'sign in again'. New workouts can stay unsaved for days while the member believes they are backed up.
expected: A bring-back that fails sets the same state as a failed send (sign in again, or not saved since a date), so the Settings line says the copy is stuck and what to do.
who: members signed in to a MettleUp account
how_often: whenever the bring-back step fails, until it works
fix_line: Record a failed bring-back like a failed send and show it in the Settings backup line

title: On a new or erased phone, every old trainer reply shows as unread again
what: Which trainer replies the member has read is kept only on this phone, and the backup and the saved copy leave it out on purpose. The replies themselves come from the gym's server. On a new phone, after a reinstall or after Erase or start over, the read mark starts at nothing, so the red count counts every reply the trainer ever sent as new. Pop-ups are guarded against this on a first look; the count is not.
expected: Replies already read on the old phone stay read, or on a first look the phone treats replies older than now as read, as it already does for pop-ups.
who: gym members who asked their trainer questions
how_often: once per new phone, reinstall or erase
fix_line: Treat replies before the first look as read, like the pop-ups, or keep the read mark with the gym
